items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: so they hired me to play the first alto. And I stayed two years in the band.

ctx.x: Well, see, my friend was over there from -- Claude Jones -- we went to Wilberforce together, and he was familiar with my playing, so they hired me to play the first alto. And I stayed two years in the band.
You traveled with Cab Calloway for two years?
